name: Booster T2
description: A highly acrobatic, open-source humanoid robot engineered for extreme agility, physical endurance, and dynamic recovery. It provides developers with a completely open software ecosystem spanning simulation training to real-world deployment.
keyFeatures: Offers up to 75 degrees of freedom (DoF) across the entire body architecture
Equipped with a 10 kg dual-arm payload capacity at a standing height of 1.4 meters
Delivers over 2 hours of continuous operational battery life
curatorNotes: Information extracted strictly from the video transcript. Accompanied by the open-source software tools `booster gym` and `booster train`. Exact release date estimated based on the news cycle context.
